Prediction-Powered Linear Regression (PPI / PPI++ / Calibrated Control Variate)

Source: R/ppi_models.R
ppi_lm.Rd

Fits an error-corrected linear regression model combining a human-validated subset with a larger LLM-coded dataset. Supports:

  • "ppi++" (default): Angelopoulos et al. (2024) M-estimation PPI++ with optimal power-tuning \(\hat{\lambda}^* \in [0, 1]\).

  • "ppi": standard Prediction-Powered Inference (lambda = 1).

  • "calibrated": coordinate-wise influence-function control-variate calibration \(\hat{\theta}_L + \hat{\Lambda}^*(\hat{\theta}_{\tilde{U}} - \hat{\theta}_{\tilde{L}})\), which adapts to slope attenuation per coefficient and also supports LLM-coded predictors via pred_map.

Usage

ppi_lm(
  formula,
  data,
  pred_col = NULL,
  unlabeled = NULL,
  method = c("ppi++", "ppi", "calibrated"),
  lambda = NULL,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  pred_map = NULL,
  weights = NULL,
  inclusion_prob = NULL
)

Arguments

formula

Two-sided linear model formula y ~ x1 + x2.

data

A data.frame containing the response, predictors, and LLM prediction column(s). When unlabeled = NULL, rows with missing response are treated as the unlabeled set.

pred_col

Name of the LLM-coded column approximating the response variable in formula. Optional if pred_map is supplied.

unlabeled

Optional separate data.frame of unlabeled observations.

method

Estimation method: "ppi++" (default), "ppi", or "calibrated".

lambda

Optional numeric override for the scalar power-tuning parameter (for "ppi++" or "ppi").

conf_level

Confidence level in (0, 1). Default 0.95.

pred_map

Optional named character vector mapping human-coded variable names in formula to their LLM-coded surrogate column names (e.g., c(distress = "llm_distress") when an LLM codes a predictor on the RHS). Automatically uses method = "calibrated" when RHS predictors are mapped.

weights

Optional Horvitz-Thompson sampling weights \(w_i > 0\) for stratified/active validation sampling (column name in data or numeric vector). Mutually exclusive with inclusion_prob.

inclusion_prob

Optional validation inclusion probabilities \(\pi_i \in (0, 1]\) (column name in data or numeric vector, e.g., from select_validation_sample()). Mutually exclusive with weights.

Value

An S3 object of class c("llm_ppi_lm", "llm_ppi").

Examples

set.seed(123)
n_tot <- 800
x <- rnorm(n_tot)
y_true <- 1.0 + 1.5 * x + rnorm(n_tot, sd = 1.0)
y_llm <- 0.6 + 0.9 * y_true + 0.4 * x + rnorm(n_tot, sd = 0.5)
df <- tibble::tibble(
  x = x,
  human_y = c(y_true[1:120], rep(NA_real_, n_tot - 120)),
  llm_y = y_llm
)
fit <- ppi_lm(human_y ~ x, data = df, pred_col = "llm_y")
fit
#> 
#> ── Prediction-Powered Inference (ppi++) 
#> Labeled n = 120 | Unlabeled N = 680 | lambda = 0.589 | CI = 95%
#> # A tibble: 2 × 7
#>   term        estimate std_error conf_low conf_high p_value var_gain
#>   <chr>          <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>     <dbl> <chr>      <dbl>
#> 1 (Intercept)     1.03    0.0619    0.904      1.15 <0.0001     2.52
#> 2 x               1.50    0.0616    1.38       1.63 <0.0001     2.77
